name: grav-skeleton-helios-course-hub
description: A single or multiple course hub skeleton for the Grav Premium Theme Helios. Includes example course hub content, Helios Course Hub plugin and Admin panel.

paragraphs: Give your courses a modern, open home on the web – with content in portable Markdown files you control.
Try the multi-course demo · single course demo

The successor to Open Course Hub – a free, open-source plugin that transforms the Grav Premium Helios theme into a multi-course companion site, built on Grav CMS with Markdown file-based content, a built-in Admin panel, and no database required. Purchasing the Helios theme also directly supports Grav's open-source development.
features: Helios Course Hub provides a ready-built course site using portable Markdown files you fully control. Highlights include visual course cards, course-aware search, and optional Git Sync for open collaborative authoring.
Show or hide the site logo icon square next to the Logo Text in the header, with optional custom Tabler icon
Configurable single course site logo link targeting the Courses Home Page or First Page of Only Listed Course

Course label (drawn from the Helios Theme versioning.labels config) with optional icon automatically displayed in the sidebar below the site name when multiple courses are published, linking to the first page of the…
Per-course favicon support: upload a favicon. file to a course root page's media to override the site favicon for that course

whatItDoes.text: Give your courses a modern, open home on the web – with content in portable Markdown files you control.

requirements.text: Need complex user management, approval workflows, or interactive features (contact forms, booking systems, user accounts)
